title: The Man Who Moved a Mountain
yt_title: He Broke a Mountain With a Hammer for 22 Years #shorts
yt_description:
In a small village in Bihar, India, the nearest doctor was 55 km away — around a mountain. After his wife Falguni was badly hurt on that rocky path, laborer Dashrath Manjhi picked up a hammer and a chisel. Alone, from 1960 to 1982, he cut a road 110 meters long and 9 meters wide straight through the rock — turning a 55 km trip into 15 km. Today India remembers him as the Mountain Man.

A true story. Sources: Wikipedia (Dashrath Manjhi); Atlas Obscura / Slate (2015).

caption:
He spent 22 years breaking a mountain with a hammer and a chisel — so nobody in his village would have to walk 55 km to a doctor again. This is Dashrath Manjhi, the Mountain Man. 🏔️ A true story.

script: In a small village in India, there was a mountain in the way. To reach the nearest town and its doctor, people had to walk all the way around it... fifty-five kilometers. One day, a poor laborer named Dashrath Manjhi watched his wife get badly hurt on that rocky path. Help came too late. So Dashrath picked up a hammer... and a chisel... and he started breaking the mountain. Alone. People called him a lunatic. He kept going. One day. Then one year. Then ten years. Stone by stone. Twenty-two years later, in nineteen eighty-two... there was a road. One hundred and ten meters long. Nine meters wide. Cut straight through the rock. The trip to town dropped from fifty-five kilometers... to just fifteen. "When I started hammering the hill, people called me a lunatic," he said. "But that steeled my resolve." They laughed at the man who wanted to move a mountain. Today, they call him... the Mountain Man.
